currentParagraphText: “That should be easily manageable,” Viridia nodded, happy to hear they weren’t talking about that many people. It would have been rough if she had to try and pull some strings to make space for everyone, as securing these slots to enter the Mycotic Depths wasn’t easy due to how much competition there was around entering.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: To clarify, there was nothing system-enforced to limit the number of people who could enter the World Wonder. All restrictions were imposed by the factions who controlled the Mycotic Depths’ entrances to prevent them from damaging or overrunning the World Wonder. It wasn’t a dungeon, and what was harvested from there wouldn’t simply pop back up whenever someone new entered. While the place was utterly massive, the fungi still needed time and space to grow.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Initial estimates are around two thousand C-grades and a thousand B-grades to arrive within the week,” the dragonkin answered.
